data.title: Spot the Fish!
data.description: Practice quick visual recognition and perceptual subitizing with cheerful fish.

challenges.instruction: Look at the fish! How many do you see?
challenges.hint: Take a quick peek at the little swimmers!
challenges.narration: Oh look! There is a little fish swimming by. How many do you see?

challenges.instruction: Flash! How many fish are here?
challenges.hint: Look closely at the pair of fish!
challenges.narration: Here come more fish swimming together! Can you tell how many there are?

challenges.instruction: Quick look! How many fish are swimming?
challenges.hint: Try to see them all at once!
challenges.narration: Wow, look at them go! How many fish are on the screen?

challenges.instruction: Flash! How many fish can you spot?
challenges.hint: Just a single friendly swimmer here.
challenges.narration: There is a lone fish exploring the water. How many do you see?

challenges.instruction: Quick peek! How many fish are there?
challenges.narration: Two fish are playing hide and seek! How many are there?

challenges.instruction: Look fast! How many fish do you see?
challenges.hint: A small school of fish is visiting!
challenges.narration: A tiny group of fish swam up to say hello. How many are in the group?

challenges.instruction: One more quick flash! How many fish?
challenges.hint: Just a couple of fish having fun!
challenges.narration: Look at these two happy fish! How many do you see?
